label: Set member values
description: Give one member values for the fields the program writes `@member_filled` (their sheet, their schedule, their connection), and clear others, all at once. Each value is checked against its field and the node's rules first, and nothing is stored if one is refused. A live trigger of the member that reads a changed value is set up again with it before `rearmed` fires, so their schedule or connection takes effect without anyone re-arming by hand.

inputs.name: member
inputs.description: The member, by the id your program uses for them (`user-42`).

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: The values to give, by `node.field` the way the program writes it: `{"read.spreadsheet": "1AbC...", "digest.cron": "0 0 7 * * *"}`. A connection field takes one of the member's connections: `{"slack.account": {"id": "<connection id>"}}`.

inputs.name: clear
inputs.description: The fields to clear, as `node.field`: each then falls back as if never given.

outputs.name: rearmed
outputs.description: The member's triggers that were set up again because they read a changed value.
